query:
UPDATE accounts
            SET opaque_record = $2,
                wrapped_root_key = COALESCE($3, wrapped_root_key),
                credentials_version = credentials_version + 1,
                root_key_version = root_key_version + CASE WHEN $3::bytea IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $1
            RETURNING credentials_version
